email_subject: Application - Growth Marketer at Startup Atlas
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Growth Marketer role at Startup Atlas. Your subscription-based ad production service solves a real pain point for Meta advertisers, and I'd love to help more businesses discover it.

My background combines SEO, content, and analytics with a technical edge. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, tracking performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I've also built and optimized sites like mirook.com, using structured data and technical audits to improve search health. I work daily with AI tools and automation to scale content and reporting.

While my experience is more organic than paid, I'm data-driven and eager to apply that to growth campaigns. I'm fluent in English and comfortable collaborating remotely.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Startup Atlas's growth.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Growth Marketer position at Startup Atlas. Your service—delivering ready-to-run Meta ads every Monday—removes a major bottleneck for businesses, and I'd love to help drive its growth with creative, data-powered marketing.

My experience sits at the intersection of SEO, content, and analytics. As a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track results and refine strategy. I also handle CMS content management in WordPress and have built and optimized sites from scratch, including mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran technical audits that measurably improved search health.

While my background is more organic than paid, I bring a strongly data-driven approach and a technical toolkit that includes Python automation and daily use of AI tools. I've used these to scale content creation and reporting, and I'm confident I can apply the same mindset to growth campaigns—testing, measuring, and iterating to attract and convert target customers. I'm also fluent in English and comfortable working remotely.

I'm drawn to Startup Atlas's collaborative, innovative environment and the opportunity to shape marketing strategy. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can contribute to your growth.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Digital marketer with a technical background, combining SEO, content, and analytics to drive measurable organic growth.
• Experienced in on-page SEO, keyword research, and technical audits, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track and optimize performance.
• Skilled in content creation and CMS management (WordPress, Elementor, Shopify), with a focus on SEO-driven blog and website content.
• Data-driven approach: daily use of AI tools and Python automation to scale content and reporting, plus experience with Google Ads.
• Strong communication and creative skills, with a track record of building and optimizing websites for search visibility and user engagement.
